exif_note: The copies are Commons' scaled thumbnails (500 to 960 px), which carry no EXIF. Each copy's EXIF (Make, Model, DateTimeOriginal, DateTimeDigitized, Software) was written back from the original upload's metadata as Commons reports it (ml/vlm/demo_exif.py); the picture was re-saved at its own JPEG quality tables (Pillow quality="keep"), same size. Photos with has_camera_metadata false had no camera fields in their source. The capture dates are the originals' (often years ago), so a check that compares them with a job window will see an old date.
